description: "Illustrations of taxation" by Harriet Martineau is a collection of didactic tales written in the early 19th century. It uses lively domestic and rural scenes to show how taxes, rents, and game laws press on everyday people, beginning with the return of the Cranston heirs to their long-shuttered estate and the frictions that follow between landowners, tradespeople, and poachers.
